summary: Manages project and workspace contexts, including configuration parsing, project metadata representation, and workspace root handling.
responsibilities: Parse and represent configuration settings and metadata from project configuration files.
Encapsulate project context including roots, configuration, and loaders.
Manage workspace context containing workspace configurations and constituent projects.
Define and represent workspace roots and workspace-specific project structures.
relationships: ProjectContext encapsulates project configuration and roots parsed from configuration files.
WorkspaceContext encapsulates workspace configuration and its associated projects.
design_decisions: Encapsulates project context, configuration settings, and workspace-level project collections using object-oriented abstractions.
